title: Irys NLRS DNA Labeling and Data Collection
author: Huang Zhihai
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.gahbsb6

steps.title: Equilibrate DNA
steps.instruction: Equilibrate DNA at room temperature for approximately 30 minutes. Pipet the mix 3 times using a wide bore tip.

steps.title: Prepare Nicking Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a 10μL reaction in a 200μL thin-wall PCR tube containing 1μL buffer, DNA, and the appropriate enzyme based on sample type.

steps.title: Mix and Incubate Nicking Reaction
steps.instruction: Mix the reaction 4 times using an Xplorer Plus Pipettor set to 8μL at the lowest speed, then pulse spin for 2 seconds. Incubate in a thermal cycler for 2 hours at 37°C with a heated lid.

steps.title: Prepare and Add Labeling Master Mix
steps.instruction: Protect from light. Prepare the Labeling Master Mix and add 5μL to the reaction.

steps.title: Mix and Incubate Labeling Reaction
steps.instruction: Mix 4 times with an Xplorer Plus Pipettor set to 13μL at the lowest speed, then pulse spin for 2 seconds. Incubate in a thermal cycler for 60 minutes at 72°C with a heated lid.

steps.title: Prepare and Add Repair Master Mix
steps.instruction: Protect from light. Prepare the Repair Master Mix and add 5μL to the reaction.

steps.title: Mix and Incubate Repair Reaction
steps.instruction: Mix 4 times with an Xplorer Plus Pipettor set to 18μL at the lowest speed, then pulse spin for 2 seconds. Incubate in a thermal cycler for 30 minutes at 37°C with a heated lid.

steps.title: Stop Reaction
steps.instruction: Place the NLR reaction on ice. Add 1μL Stop Solution, mix by gently stirring 5 times with the pipet tip, and pulse spin for 2 seconds.

steps.title: Prepare Staining Master Mix
steps.instruction: Protect from light. Equilibrate Staining Master Mix components to room temperature and prepare the mix.

steps.title: Stain DNA
steps.instruction: Aliquot 40μL of the Staining Master Mix into a 0.6mL amber tube. Transfer NLR to the Staining Mix using a standard tip and pulse spin for 2 seconds. Gently mix NLRS DNA 5 times with a wide bore tip set to 50μL and pulse spin for 2 seconds. Place reactions at 4°C overnight for uniform staining.

steps.title: Equilibrate and Mix Stained DNA
steps.instruction: Protect from light. Equilibrate NLRS to room temperature for approximately 30 minutes. Gently mix DNA 3 times with a wide bore tip set to 50μL and pulse spin for 2 seconds.

steps.title: Quantitate DNA with Qubit
steps.instruction: Perform Qubit quantification to ensure NLRS DNA concentration is 3-10ng/μL with CV < 25%.

substeps.instruction: Remove 2μL aliquots from the Top, Middle, and Bottom of the sample into separate Qubit Assay tubes.
Sonicate for 10 minutes in a bath sonicator.
Add 180μL Qubit reagent mix, vortex for 5 seconds, and pulse spin for 2 seconds.
Incubate at room temperature for at least 2 minutes and quantitate with Qubit 2.0 Fluorimeter.

steps.title: Collect Data
steps.instruction: Load the sample into an Irys chip and start data collection with a 30-cycle run on the Irys system.
